name: text_to_speech
description: Convert text to speech. Returns an audio URL. Speaks with any voice this box offers -- OpenAI, Gemini, ElevenLabs premium or cloned voices, local and on-box voices -- by its voice id from list_tts_voices (e.g. elevenlabs:<voice_id>). Omit voice to speak with the box's default voice.

voice.description: Voice id from list_tts_voices, written provider:voice (e.g. elevenlabs:<voice_id> for a premium or cloned voice). A bare OpenAI voice name also works. Omit to use the box's default voice.

model.description: Optional model override for the voice's provider. Omit to use the box's model for that provider.

returns: Returns an audio URL and the voice and model the box used
